excel_template.queryString: SELECT SUBSTR(DVUT_DVUT,2,1) STR1, M.GIATRI STR2, SUM (NVL (DVUT_D7, 0)) / 1000000 D1, SUM (NVL (DVUT_D9, 0)) / 1000000 D2, SUM (NVL (DVUT_D10, 0)) / 1000000 D3 FROM BCTD_DVUT_RG, DMPOS Y, (SELECT PO_POSFLG, PO_MACN, PO_MA FROM DMPOS WHERE PO_MA = $P{PARA_MAPGD}) Z, (SELECT KHOA_2, GIATRI FROM DMKHAC WHERE KHOA_1='17' AND KHOA_2 IN ('11','12','13','14')) M WHERE DVUT_NGAYBC = $P{PARA_NGAYBC} AND DVUT_DVUT = M.KHOA_2 AND DVUT_MAPGD = Y.PO_MA AND DECODE(Z.PO_POSFLG,'H',1,'S',Y.PO_MA , Y.PO_MACN) = DECODE(Z.PO_POSFLG,'H',1,Z.PO_MA) GROUP BY DVUT_DVUT, M.GIATRI ORDER BY DVUT_DVUT
select distinct decode($P{PARA_MAPGD},'000100','Hội sở chính',add_city) str1 from po850mb where main_pos=$P{PARA_MAPGD}
select to_char(EXTRACT(MONTH from to_date($P{PARA_NGAYBC}))) STR1, to_char(EXTRACT(YEAR from to_date($P{PARA_NGAYBC}))) STR2 from dual

select rownum d1, TENCT str1, DS_CHOVAYT d2, DS_CHOVAYN d3, DS_THUNOT d4, DS_THUNON d5, DS_XOANOT d6, DS_XOANON d7, TONG_DN d8, TYLE_NO_QHAN d9, TYLE_NO_KHOANH d10 from (SELECT GIATRI TENCT, KHOA_2 MACT, 'SDV', case when (KHOA_2 = '92' OR KHOA_2 = '93' OR KHOA_2 = '94' OR KHOA_2 = '96') then 'Cho vay một số d? ï¿½n vốn nươc ngoài khác' else GIATRI end as CHTRINH, NVL(sum(CTR_D1)/1000000,0) DS_CHOVAYT, NVL(sum(CTR_D2)/1000000,0) DS_CHOVAYN, NVL(sum(CTR_D3)/1000000,0) DS_THUNOT, NVL(sum(CTR_D4)/1000000,0) DS_THUNON, NVL(sum(CTR_D5)/1000000,0) DS_XOANOT, NVL(sum(CTR_D6)/1000000,0) DS_XOANON, NVL(sum(CTR_D7)/1000000,0) TONG_DN, CASE WHEN SUM(CTR_D7) > 0 THEN NVL(sum(CTR_D9)/1000000,0)*100/NVL(sum(CTR_D7)/1000000,0) ELSE 0 END TYLE_NO_QHAN, CASE WHEN SUM(CTR_D7) > 0 THEN NVL(sum(CTR_D10)/1000000,0)*100/NVL(sum(CTR_D7)/1000000,0) ELSE 0 END TYLE_NO_KHOANH FROM DMKHAC A, BCTD_CHTRINH B, DMPOS Y,(SELECT PO_POSFLG, PO_MACN, PO_MA FROM DMPOS WHERE PO_MA = $P{PARA_MAPGD}) Z WHERE KHOA_1 = '07' AND CTR_CHTRINH = A.KHOA_2 AND B.CTR_MAPGD = Y.PO_MA AND DECODE(Z.PO_POSFLG,'H',1,'S',Y.PO_MA , Y.PO_MACN) = DECODE(Z.PO_POSFLG,'H',1,Z.PO_MA) AND CTR_NGAYBC = TO_DATE($P{PARA_NGAYBC}) group by KHOA_2,GIATRI, THUTU order by THUTU, KHOA_2)
